uk-fhrs.label: 영국 식품위생 등록업소
uk-fhrs.source: Food Standards Agency, Food Hygiene Rating Scheme — Restaurant/Cafe/Canteen, Pub/bar/nightclub, Takeaway/sandwich shop. Hygiene ratings deliberately not carried.

fr-alim.label: 프랑스 위생점검 등록업소
fr-alim.source: DGAL Alim'confiance — official food hygiene inspection results, 'Restaurants' only. Hygiene verdicts deliberately not carried.

dk-smiley.label: 덴마크 스마일리 등록업소
dk-smiley.source: Fødevarestyrelsen Smiley — Serveringsvirksomhed (Restauranter, Uden behandling). Smiley ratings deliberately not carried.
dk-smiley.license: Danish public-sector open data terms — © Fødevarestyrelsen

us-nyc.label: 뉴욕시 식품위생 허가업소
us-nyc.source: NYC DOHMH restaurant inspection results, one row per CAMIS permit. Inspection scores and grades deliberately not carried; cuisine description is a fact and is kept.

ca-toronto.label: 토론토 식품업소 (DineSafe)
ca-toronto.source: City of Toronto DineSafe, collapsed to one row per establishment. No establishment-type field exists in the file, so groceries and bakeries are included. Infraction details, severity and fines deliberately not carried.

us-chicago.label: 시카고 식품위생 허가업소
us-chicago.source: City of Chicago food inspections, collapsed by licence number, filtered to restaurant/bakery/tavern/coffee shop. Uses aka_name (the name in use) over dba_name. Scores, results and violations deliberately not carried.
us-chicago.license: City of Chicago Open Data — public domain

hk-fehd.label: 홍콩 식당 면허 (FEHD)
hk-fehd.source: FEHD restaurant licences (General, Light Refreshment, Marine), daily XML. Names are the SHOP SIGN as displayed. Coordinates from the Hong Kong government's own Address Lookup Service (ALS).
hk-fehd.license: Open data — © Food and Environmental Hygiene Department, HKSAR

us-boston.label: 보스턴 식품업소 면허
us-boston.source: City of Boston food establishment licences, one row per licence, filtered to licstatus=Active so closed premises never arrive. Retail Food (grocery) excluded. Violations and results deliberately not carried.

au-melbourne.label: 멜버른 카페·레스토랑 조사
au-melbourne.source: City of Melbourne business census, latest year only (2024), CBD and inner suburbs rather than greater Melbourne. Not a licence register — Australia registers per council — so this is a census of trading businesses. Seat counts dropped.
au-melbourne.license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 — City of Melbourne

fr-bouche.label: 프랑스 식품 장인 (빵집·정육·치즈)
fr-bouche.source: DGAL Alim'confiance — Métiers de bouche: boulangerie-pâtisserie, boucherie-charcuterie, traiteur, fromagerie, poissonnerie, chocolatier, glacier. Hygiene verdicts deliberately not carried.

us-nystate.label: 뉴욕주 식품업소 (뉴욕시 외)
us-nystate.source: NY State DOH — Food Service Establishment: Last Inspection
